summary: The AI constructor golden path is covered by deterministic assistant, backend Action Spine, browser UI, and negative runtime/deploy fixtures. The accepted evidence proves durable workflow creation, validation, role readiness, deployment, case.start, persisted work item dispatch effects, monitor/work item visibility, and refusal of invalid or non-executable workflows.
target_invariant: A workflow created by the assistant only counts as runnable when durable Action Spine actions persist the workflow, validation and deploy receipts are ready, case.start succeeds against an executable workflow, and the first assigned work item plus dispatch receipt are observable. Preview-only, textual-only, or partial failure paths cannot be counted as saved or runnable.

acceptance_steps.name: create durable workflow definition
acceptance_steps.durability_contract: workflow.create via Action Spine persists workflow state; UI reload verifies persisted state rather than client-only canvas state.

acceptance_steps.name: validate graph and runtime readiness
acceptance_steps.durability_contract: workflow.validate returns canonical readiness with deployment_blocker=false and case_start_blocker=false on the success path; negative paths expose stable blocking codes.

acceptance_steps.name: assign or request required roles
acceptance_steps.durability_contract: role.create creates an explicit manual role; missing role negative coverage blocks deploy and start.

acceptance_steps.name: deploy triggers and effects
acceptance_steps.durability_contract: workflow.deploy persists executable lifecycle state and deploy record before runtime start; side-effect failures return non-success and demote to validated.

acceptance_steps.name: start a case
acceptance_steps.durability_contract: case.start succeeds only for executable workflows; non-executable workflows return WORKFLOW_NOT_EXECUTABLE and create no case.

acceptance_steps.name: create and dispatch the first work item
acceptance_steps.durability_contract: The first work item is pending and assigned to the role; workitem.dispatch persists a runtime effect and target-detail receipt.

acceptance_steps.name: show observable receipts and monitor navigation
acceptance_steps.durability_contract: Assistant normalized response includes action receipts and monitor navigation; browser path verifies visible operator work item state.

negative_coverage.expected: assistant sequence stops before runtime and no case is started
ROLE_UNRESOLVABLE readiness blocker, deploy failure, no case
WORKFLOW_DEPLOY_SIDE_EFFECT_FAILED, workflow demoted to validated, no runnable case
runtime effect becomes dead_letter and no delivered marker is written
